decisions.reason: This SEO relaunch support service is very close to the firm's existing e-commerce, search marketing, analytics, and shop optimization capabilities, and its presence on its own page in both 2023 and 2024 suggests the firm could learn from client demand and continue refining it rather than withdraw it.

These SEO workshops also build directly on the firm's established knowledge base and service portfolio, so absorptive capacity is high, but as a newer 2024 offer with a less proven market record than D it has a somewhat higher chance of being discontinued if uptake stays limited.
